'''Sarn Ko''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a freelance [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After doing sensitive work for the Empire, he was deemed as "knowing too much" and was sent to the [[Shadow Town]] prison on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. His resistance to drugs allowed him to escape before a bomb was installed in his skull and he desired revenge. He later asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] citizen to shut down the Empire's prison complex in Shadow Town by destroying the labs and equipment used to install bombs in people's heads.<ref name="TOR" />
